li.label: ate hawkbat egg
li.description: That Hawkbat egg was astonishing. Truly a dish fit for an Emperor.

li.label: ate mudhorn egg
li.description: Utini!

li.label: ate rikknit ovum
li.description: Despite the pungent aroma, that Rikknit ovum was exquisite.

li.label: ate manax fungus
li.description: Incredible, the fungus flavour is so aromatic and poweful. No wonder they pay so much for this stuff!

li.label: ate gornt meat
li.description: That was a really tasty meat. Those Gornt taste great!

li.label: ate rycrit meat
li.description: That was some delicious meat, it can only have been Rycrit!

li.label: ate acklay claw
li.description: These claws are so tender and sweet, the buttery flavour lingers on the tongue.

li.label: ate nexu tongue
li.description: Mmmm, this meat is delightfully chewy and has such an exotic texture.

li.label: ate rancor heart
li.description: There's something in that meat, I'm staring to feel...Strong!

li.label: ate roe
li.description: How beautifully rich and creamy, quite the delicacy!

li.label: drank blue milk
li.description: Ah, can't argue with a bit of blue milk...

li.label: drank green milk
li.description: Sithspit! What karking thing made this?! It tastes like it's gone bad INSIDE the animal!

li.label: ate bloddle
li.description: Ah, you can't beat the aroma of cooked bloddle.

li.label: ate chak-root
li.description: What a flavour, there's no mistaking the tangy sweetness of chak-root.

li.label: ate meiloorun
li.description: So juicy and refreshing, meiloorun is such a nice treat.

li.label: ate jogan fruit
li.description: Sweet with a crisp texture, it has to be jogan fruit.

li.label: ate muja fruit
li.description: Simply sweet and delicious, muja fruit without a doubt.

li.label: ate raw much-fungus
li.description: Ixta! This munch-fungus is so spongy and bland. It needs preparing properly!

li.label: ate much-fungus
li.description: Munch-fungus has such a pleasant flavor when prepared correctly, it really is very versatile.

li.label: ate much-fungus bread
li.description: This Munch-fungus bread is so tasty and filling; just like Mal'aa used to make!

li.label: ate doshian jelly
li.description: I can't tell if it's overly tangy or just stinging my mouth. Quite the sensation.

li.label: ate fleek eel
li.description: This fleek eel flesh is so rich and fatty, quite the delicacy.

li.label: ate paddy frog
li.description: I swear by the Force the legs of that thing just kicked in my mouth. Made me feel like a Hutt!

li.label: ate tach gland
li.description: WHAT was I kriffing thinking?! Simian brains are bitter and disgusting...

li.label: ate tough meat
li.description: Ugh...That meat was too tough and chewy.

li.label: ate tender meat
li.description: That meat was very tender and fatty...yum!

li.label: spat on
li.description: Schutta! That disgusting beast just spat on me!

li.label: webbed
li.description: Ah! It's sticky! What is it?

li.label: soothing song
li.description: That creature made such a calm and soothing sound, it almost felt like I was dreaming it.
